implemented_requirements.requirement: Two vertical paddles, one per player, controllable up/down
implemented_requirements.evidence: paddle.py defines Paddle with up_key/down_key, Game creates left_paddle and right_paddle using settings.KEY_LEFT_UP/DOWN and KEY_RIGHT_UP/DOWN, and Paddle.update reads pygame.key.get_pressed to move vertically.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball moves and bounces off top and bottom edges
implemented_requirements.evidence: ball.py: Ball.update checks y <= 0 and y >= SCREEN_HEIGHT - size and calls bounce_vertical() which inverts dy.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball bounces off paddles with angle deflection and speed increase
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: handle_collisions detects collision, gets offset via Paddle.hit_offset, then Ball.bounce_off_paddle(offset) which reverses dx, sets dy based on offset * BALL_ANGLE_FACTOR, increments speed, and normalizes.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Scoring when a player misses the ball
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: check_scoring() awards a point to the opposite side when ball.rect.right < 0 or ball.rect.left > SCREEN_WIDTH.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Winning score threshold and game‑over state
implemented_requirements.evidence: scoreboard.py: get_winner() returns side when score >= settings.WINNING_SCORE. game.py: _after_point() switches state to GAME_OVER if a winner exists.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball reset after each point with a serve delay
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: _after_point() calls ball.reset(serve_direction) and sets serve_timer = settings.SERVE_DELAY_FRAMES; update() skips ball.update while serve_timer > 0.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Rendering of paddles, ball, scores, and UI (menu, game over)
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: draw() renders paddles, ball, scoreboard, center line, and appropriate text for MENU and GAME_OVER states.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Configurable settings (window size, colors, speeds, controls, winning score)
implemented_requirements.evidence: settings.py defines all tunable constants used throughout the code.

judge.summary: The provided source files implement a complete two‑player Pong game meeting all core requirements: controllable vertical paddles, ball physics with wall and paddle bounces, scoring, a configurable winning score, and ball reset with a serve delay. The code is coherent, uses pygame correctly, and appears ready to run, leading to a pass verdict.
